messages:
Asha Patel: Heads up — noticed several Feb invoices with a negative 'reserved capacity adjustment' but missing the metered GPU usage lines. Example INV-17321 shows -$1,200 credit and no compute lines.
Priya Rao: Which customers are affected?
Asha Patel: AcmeCloud, NebulaApps, Clearview (so far). All hit in the Feb batch run.
Liam Chen: I pulled the billing-generator v2 logs. Job 987654 failed inside the proration step with a `splitLineitemException` during line item aggregation for accounts that had both reserved capacity and metered tier changes.
billing-bot: billing-generator v2 job 987654 status: WARN proration-step failed for 14 customers (see logs link).
Alex Gomez: Stripe shows duplicate invoice CREATE events for those accounts — two invoices created within ~2s for some customers. Could be a race between reissue and proration.
Liam Chen: I traced it to commit 3f4b2a4 — it changed how we atomically move reserved credits when plan tier changes. The race can leave orphaned negative adjustment lines while dropping the metered line into a NULL invoice.
Asha Patel: Can we revoke/roll back those invoices? Customers are seeing negative totals and unexpected refunds.
Liam Chen: Plan: patch hotfix to de-dupe by external_id + creation window, then re-run reconciliation for affected accounts and reissue clean invoices. I can push the hotfix tonight and run the reissue script. Need finance sign-off to reissue/void invoices.
Priya Rao: ETA on fix and impact to customers? I need language for support tickets.
Liam Chen: Impact: ~14 invoices, gross amount ~ $47,200 affected (mix of negative adjustments and missing compute lines). For customers: we'll void duplicate/incorrect invoices and reissue corrected ones. ETA: hotfix deploy + re-run = 4h from now, manual audit afterwards.
Asha Patel: Okay, please proceed. Add a short customer note template once you have details. Also log this for refunds/payout hold.
Alex Gomez: Putting vendor payout for those customers on hold until we confirm final invoice set.
Liam Chen: Deploying hotfix now. Patch includes an additional idempotency check and a guard in proration. SQL to find orphaned lines I used:```sql
SELECT id, account_id, amount, description FROM line_items
WHERE invoice_id IS NULL AND period = '2025-02' AND type = 'metered';
```
Liam Chen: I'll run the fix and post results here. Oncall is me tonight.
Priya Rao: Thanks — I'll update the support tickets and flag affected accounts with a note.
billing-bot: Deployment: billing-generator v2 -> v2.0.1 by liamchen at 2025-03-01T03:00:00Z (hotfix).
Liam Chen: Re-run started at 1758664380.
Liam Chen: Re-run completed at 1758664420 — created 14 corrected invoices, voided 12 duplicates, reversed 9 phantom credits. Manual audit in progress; total net delta ~ +$800 (rounding adjustments).
Asha Patel: Great work — please prepare a short postmortem (root cause + mitigation + customer comms) for #postmortems tomorrow.
Liam Chen: Will do. I'll attach logs and the reconciliation CSV.
Priya Rao: I'll draft the customer-facing note and send it for review.
Asha Patel: Thanks everyone.
Liam Chen: Closing this thread after audit complete, will update with final numbers. (1758664450)
